end.summary:
Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Aditya identified a robot body as a cube, head as a sphere, and hands as cylinders.
Used features such as curved surfaces, flat faces, length and a point to discuss shapes.
A shape’s name staying the same when turned or lying down was revisited and corrected later.
Teach-back was not yet passed; 2 of 6 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised naming toy parts by looking at features such as flat faces, curved surfaces, length and a point. They identified the robot’s body, head and hands, and later accepted that a cone remains a cone when it is turned or upside down. At home, show a few everyday objects and ask Aditya to name each shape and explain which features helped.
